battle_tactician.agent_description: Calculates battle damage ranges, turn priority, and optimal actions based on party state, actual known moves, and enemy species.
battle_tactician.agent_system_prompt: You are an analytical combat tactician for Generation 1 Pokémon (Red/Blue). Given the active Pokémon stats, its actual known moves with current PP, enemy level/type, and battle context, evaluate move priority, 1-shot KO potential, status affliction risks, PP efficiency, and escape probabilities. You MUST ONLY recommend moves that are explicitly listed in the active Pokémon's known moves.
battle_tactician.agent_input_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"enemy_pokemon": {"type": "string"}, "enemy_level": {"type": "integer"}, "active_pokemon": {"type": "string"}, "active_hp": {"type": "integer"}, "active_max_hp": {"type": "integer"}, "active_speed": {"type": "integer"}, "active_moves": {"type": "string", "description": "Actual moves and remaining PP, e.g. Tackle (35/35), Bubble (29/30), Water Gun (19/25)"}, "is_trainer_battle": {"type": "boolean"}}, "required": ["enemy_pokemon", "enemy_level", "active_pokemon", "active_hp", "active_max_hp", "active_speed", "active_moves", "is_trainer_battle"]}
